You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: How often must the Effer truck-mounted hydraulic crane at position 7 of the IGEA list, built in 2017, be verified?

Facts:
[0] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[1] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[2] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[3] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[4] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[5] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[6] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[7] lifting machinery maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[8] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[9] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[10] Dynamic test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations (the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[11] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a copy of the load plate or load table (a copy of the load plate or load table) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[12] lifting machinery marking — requiresMeasure — legible, indelible and in an un-coded form (legible, indelible and in an un-coded form) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[13] manually loaded trucks for collection of household refuse — listedIn — Manually loaded trucks for the collection of household refuse (annex IV point 13) [condition: incorporating a compression mechanism] [DIR, Annex IV]
[14] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[15] loading control — requiresMeasure — fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: Machinery with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [DIR, Annex I, 4.2.2]
[16] machinery serving fixed landings — listedIn — 6.4. (Annex I, point 6.4) [DIR, Annex I, 6.4]
[17] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture of machinery (internal checks on the manufacture of machinery) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[18] manually loaded household refuse collection trucks with compression mechanism — listedIn — Manually loaded trucks for the collection of household refuse (annex i, part b, point 13) [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 13]
[19] Static test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected (the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[20] movement of the machinery — requiresMeasure — must depend on safe positioning (must depend on safe positioning) [condition: Where it does not give rise to other risks] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[21] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (verify that machinery bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[22] essential requirement 1.6.2, access to operating positions and servicing points — requiresMeasure — allow access in safety (allow access in safety) [condition: where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment and maintenance of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.2]
[23] loading control 4.2.2 — requiresMeasure — devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kg or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[24] 4.3.3 machinery with configuration-dependent working load — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the lifting machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[25] hydraulic-powered roof supports — listedIn — hydraulic-powered roof supports (annex I, part B, point 12.2) [condition: Machinery for underground working of the following types:] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 12]
[26] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[27] devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods — listedIn — 14. (annex I, part B, point 14) [condition: involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 14]
[28] EssentialRequirement 3.2.3, positions for other persons — requiresMeasure — appropriate positions (appropriate positions) [condition: If the conditions of use provide that persons other than the driver may occasionally or regularly be transported by the machinery or work on it] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.3]
[29] Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — listedIn — 4. (annex I, part A, point 4) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 4]
[30] 4.1.2.7 operating position of machinery — requiresMeasure — widest possible view of trajectories (widest possible view of trajectories) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.7]
[31] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — EC type-examination procedure (ec type-examination procedure) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[32] movement of the carrier of machinery serving fixed landings — requiresMeasure — rigidly guided (rigidly guided) [condition: to and at the landings] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.1]
[33] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance (full quality assurance) [DIR, Annex X]
[34] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[35] essential requirement 6.4.3, access to the carrier — requiresMeasure — guards at the landings and on the carrier (guards at the landings and on the carrier) [condition: taking into consideration the foreseeable range of goods and persons to be lifted] [DIR, Annex I, 6.4.3]
[36] carrier designed as a workstation — requiresMeasure — provision shall be made to ensure stability and to prevent hazardous movements (provision shall be made to ensure stability and to prevent hazardous movements) [condition: Where the carrier is designed as a workstation] [REG, Annex III, 6.3.2]
[37] lifting machinery working load per configuration — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[38] portable fixing and other impact machinery — requiresMeasure — enabling device (enabling device) [condition: unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.2.1]
[39] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[40] portable fixing and other impact machinery — requiresMeasure — enabling device (enabling device) [condition: unless the machinery or related product is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[41] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — contents of the logbook (contents of the logbook) [condition: if the latter is not supplied with the lifting machinery] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[42] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall use the appropriate verification methods (shall use the appropriate verification methods) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.1]
[43] machinery or related products — requiresMeasure — fitted with indicators (fitted with indicators) [condition: as required for safe operation] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.2]
[44] registro di controllo delle attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — siano curati la tenuta e l'aggiornamento (siano curati la tenuta e l'aggiornamento) [condition: per cui lo stesso è previsto] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 4]
[45] internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.4]
[46] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available (ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[47] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.4]
[48] driver checking position of devices exceeding clearance zone — requiresMeasure — the means of checking easily (the means of checking easily) [condition: Where, for operating purposes, machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[49] guards for moving transmission parts with frequent access — requiresMeasure — Interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [condition: where frequent access is envisaged] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
